text: The department retained an expert on human population evacuations due to natural disasters.
provenance: The department retained an expert. His name was Doctor Cova and the opinion describes him as an expert on human population evacuations due to natural disasters.

text: He stated there is no known method to enumerate who evacuated and who did not, in a given area and time frame, in response to a broadcast evacuation order.

text: Read that as engineering rather than law. A broadcast is a signal sent to nobody in particular. It has no delivery receipt.
provenance: Read that as a piece of engineering rather than as a piece of law. A broadcast is a signal sent to nobody in particular. It has no delivery receipt.
